description: This file defines the 'DdlWriter' class responsible for serializing 'DocumentObject' instances into DDL (Document Description Language) format. It provides methods to write individual documents or collections to strings or files, with configurable indentation and formatting options.

classes.name: DdlWriter
classes.description: A class for writing DocumentObject instances to DDL format, supporting various output methods including strings and files with indentation controls.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying serializer and stream writer, releasing resources.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the serializer buffer to ensure all data is written out.

methods.name: WriteDocument
methods.description: Serializes a DocumentObject or DocumentObjectCollection to the DDL format.

methods.name: WriteToString
methods.description: Serializes DocumentObject or DocumentObjectCollection into a string representation with specified indentation.

methods.name: WriteToFile
methods.description: Serializes DocumentObject or DocumentObjectCollection and writes the output to a specified file with indentation options.
